contentSections.heading: Frequently asked Questions
contentSections.text: Frequently asked Questions 1. What is Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress? Back Magic Pro Plus is a doctor-recommended orthopedic medium firm mattress featuring 5-zone dual density support layer. Made from high-density rebonded foam, it combines firm orthopedic support with ergonomic design. It’s part of Duroflex’s Duropedic range, which is exclusively approved by the National Health Academy(NHA). 2. What problem does Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress solve? It addresses back pain, poor posture, spinal misalignment, and pressure point discomfort through targeted 5-zone orthopedic support. The dual-density layer independently supports five body zones, preventing spinal strain. 3. Who is Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress best for? Ideal for athletes and fitness enthusiasts, back pain sufferers, individuals with postural issues, desk job professionals with extended working hours, those prone to night sweats, back pain sufferers, and high-performance individuals requiring deep restorative sleep. 4. How does Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress work? The mattress incorporates a 5 Zone Orthopedic Support system that aligns crucial body zones to promote proper spinal alignment and balanced weight distribution. It’s part of Duroflex’s Duropedic range, which is doctor-recommended for targeted support and approved by the National Health Academy. 5. How is Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress different from alternatives? Unlike basic mattresses, it offers zonal support tailored to different body areas for improved posture. It's designed specifically for back pain relief and spinal support, not just general comfort. 6. How does Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress feel? It is medium firm and supportive, targeting orthopedic support. It uses structured support layers for spinal alignment rather than a soft, plush feel. The rebonded foam prevents excessive sinking while maintaining proper spinal alignment. 7. Does Back Magic Pro Plus Orthopedic Mattress come with a warranty? Yes, it comes with a 7-year conditional warranty, and offers 10 Day Replacement Policy. 8. How to care for this Mattress? Always use a mattress protector to protect against dust, spills, and allergens, and get it professionally deep-cleaned twice a year for better hygiene. Do not flip or turn the mattress, avoid ironing on it, and never fold or bend it as it may damage the mattress structure.
